{"action_id":"rewrite_priority","rationale":"The grouped priority implementation targets the baseline's deep encode-then-decode path, computing onehot winners directly and forming the index with parallel reductions. This is the stronger structural opportunity to reduce whole-design maximum arrival, accounting for the mux inputs' 0.50 ns external delay and fixed independent block mapping. It preserves highest-bit priority and the zero-request outputs (valid=0, index=0, onehot=1), while leaving mux default behavior unchanged. Timing improvement and compliance with the 2719.608320 um^2 area cap are estimates, not verified PPA results."}
